notes.title: My latest game SLASHVIVAL is ready for WISHLIST!
notes.content:
Hey folks! :cozydarkseer:

I'm happy to announce that I've just posted the steam store page for my latest game named before as Project Utopia and currently known as [i]Slashvival[/i]! :cozybrawlhalla1:

As some of you may know, it consists of a third person 3D low poly survival game in which every day is different!

Wake up in the morning and leave the house with only one objective: gather as many resources as you can before the night comes! You don't want to know what happens at night...

[b]I will be working on it this next 4 months full non-stop to make it an incredible experience! I would really appreciate it if you could wishlist it, as these little things keep me motivated to keep making games![/b] :OrangeKoi: :spelunky:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/990410/Slashvival/

notes.title: WHY DID I START MAKING GAMES?
notes.content:
[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30504469/133b788f3c98122e2a8e465dff2035ea493e91ef.jpg][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30504469/9d768a8f18d33564c25174841ba5efcdc2b49399.jpg[/img][/url]
Well, it all started when I was barely [b]3 years old[/b] and was a complete fanboy of [b]Pokémon[/b], after watching the anime series in spanish. Also loved [b]Spiderman[/b] and dressed as him in halloween after having watched the first movie. During that time, I remember I used to have a gold Pokedex which would tell me (just like in the series) cool facts about Johto Pokémons.  

One day, I saw this kid in the school bus playing with the [b]new Game Boy Advance[/b]! At first, I didn’t know what it was and asked myself “What is that machine for?”. I wanted to try it, so in the end we agreed to switch his Game Boy Advance for my Pokedex for 1 week. 

Next, the moment I got that machinery into my hands with the title of “SPIDERMAN” written in the main menu of the Game Boy Advance game they made for the first movie of Spiderman… [i]I knew from that day on something would change in my life[/i]… And it did…

I ended up returning the console like 2 months later after her mother had yelled quite a few times to me, but when she asked to give it back I would always reply with a [i]“I left it at home”[/i] excuse xD Later that year, for [b]Christmas[/b] I got my own Game Boy Advance with Super Mario World with it!

From this point on, video games have always been an [b]important element of my life[/b], just like sports. I mainly practiced tennis, soccer, table-tennis and swimming. 

Video games have really [b]helped me in rough times[/b], when I needed to isolate myself. This was very useful: at boring family meetings, at boring school bus trails, when my parents argued and I couldn’t go anywhere, when they helped me socialize and make new friends; as I’ve always been the shyest person of my neighborhood. Also, very importantly, during middle school I had no friends and got bullied either by classmates or by teachers, it was a very tough part...

But they’ve also [b]made me laugh and have fun[/b] when playing coop games with a friend beside! I’ve also discovered amazing worlds that you couldn’t by just watching a movie or reading a book for say.

Once my parents made me clear that I couldn’t become a professional tennis player T.T, the only thing left for me where video games…

So that’s why I started making video games, they were my [b]true love[/b] since the beginning of my life, they have meant so much to me and helped me so much that I want to make other people feel the same way. To help them isolate themselves when they need it. It doesn’t matter if they’re having a bad day or if they’re suffering a lot, I want to alleviate even if it’s just a little that pain they’re going through. And most importantly, I make games to [b]make people have fun[/b].

You can find more devlogs here: [url=https://johnnyginard.tumblr.com]https://johnnyginard.tumblr.com[/url]
